geometry.geometry_revision: Original 28 vertices, 50 panels, 76 paths at neutral; optional PET junction cut variant explicitly changes manufacturing topology
geometry.relief_definition: Omit PET-only border segments adjacent to source vertices for fraction f of each original edge at each end. PLA facets remain. Free boundaries are real cuts, not an intact-film stiffness claim. f=0 restores intact source pattern.

frames.fea_frame: Origin lower perimeter center; Z upwards; source rotated +90 degrees about X and uniformly scaled from 250-unit width to 0.03 m
frames.isaac_frame: Same orientation plus recorded vertical display offset
frames.transform_fea_to_isaac: Identity rotation and scale; translation [0,0,offset] in saved calculation
frames.positive_angle_direction: Right-hand relative frame rotation vector, not independent Euler angles

material.model: Finite-rotation Green membrane strain / plane-stress StVK plus discrete hinges; uncalibrated
material.assumptions: Only thicknesses supplied by user. Moduli, crease law, PET gap, winch law, masses and contact are provisional. Bending/membrane scales are separate; 0.01 is NOT measured PLA/PET behavior.

mesh.element_type: Triangular membrane with discrete bending hinges and explicit PET-only borders
mesh.mesh_revision: Per-study configuration and counts recorded in raw studies; optional open relief boundaries; only referenced nodes become free DOFs
mesh.convergence_summary: Parent intact-shell spatial response gate failed; no spatial convergence demonstrated for relief cuts. Static residual, 3% membrane-strain, 8% height, and proper midsurface-intersection guards remain enabled.

boundary_conditions: Static upper perimeter frame fixed; lower frame and shell free under applied loads
Roof interiors deform; only square perimeters rigid
No prescribed joint angle in winch or cable-force experiments
Drop: both frames dynamic; four frictionless compliant normal foot contacts
loads: Existing independent constant-tension mode retained, 12 pull-only strands
Elastic winch: T=min(k*max(L-L0,0),force_cap), inactive cables have T=0; potential is the exact integral of this law
Winch pull shortens active cable rest lengths relative to neutral; unselected cables slack, no implied preload or physical guide routing
Optional lower-frame resultant force distributed over its perimeter
70 mm foot-first drop; assumed 30 g upper / 20 g lower assembly, shell mass included, no payload, unloaded cables

solver.software: Original project CPU NumPy/SciPy/Torch shell shown inside Isaac Sim
solver.version: Implementation commit and source-file hashes in linked run manifest
solver.analysis_type: Quasistatic load continuation; separate implicit backward-Euler drop diagnostic
solver.notes: Gauss-Newton scaling includes active elastic winch tangent but does not alter energy. Higher iteration allowance and smaller take-up steps do not relax acceptance guards.

limitations: Not a reproduction of the measured video force-motion curves
Large-range self-contact and folding-branch continuation unresolved
Proper midsurface intersection guard is not finite-thickness contact, coplanar contact or CCD
PET plasticity, hysteresis, adhesive damage, anisotropy, actuator and guide routing uncalibrated
Modified relief drop stops before peak impact; no survival verdict
No training and no ML baseline promotion

review.notes: Local experimental handoff; publication pending authorization
